title: Whole, half and quarter turns
summary: Use position words and explore turns in both directions.
subject: maths

difficultyRamp.within: Q1 uses in front and behind. Q2 uses above and below. Q3 identifies a 1-quarter turn from right. Q4 identifies a 2-quarter turn from down. Q5 identifies a 1-quarter turn from up. Q6 predicts a 1-quarter turn from left. Q7 predicts a 1-quarter turn from right. Q8 predicts a 2-quarter turn from down. Q9 predicts a 1-quarter turn from left. Q10 predicts a 1-quarter turn from down.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy uses position words, whole and half turns, then supported quarter-turn predictions. Medium identifies and predicts quarter and half turns in both directions. Hard adds three-quarter turns, varied starts and whole-turn distinctions. All use one shared arrow diagram and single-choice spatial fluency to avoid interaction changes.

questions.prompt: A tree is behind Pip. Where is Pip?
questions.explanation: Pip is in front of the tree because the tree is behind him.

questions.prompt: Pip is below a kite. Where is the kite?
questions.explanation: The kite is above Pip because Pip is below it.

questions.prompt: Follow the orange path. How much does the arrow turn?
questions.explanation: A quarter turn goes one of four equal parts of the way round.

questions.prompt: Follow the orange path. How much does the arrow turn?
questions.explanation: A half turn goes halfway round.

questions.prompt: Follow the orange path. How much does the arrow turn?
questions.explanation: A quarter turn goes one of four equal parts of the way round.

questions.prompt: The arrow makes a quarter turn clockwise. Which way does it point now?
questions.explanation: From pointing left, a quarter turn clockwise finishes pointing up.

questions.prompt: The arrow makes a quarter turn anti-clockwise. Which way does it point now?
questions.explanation: From pointing right, a quarter turn anti-clockwise finishes pointing up.

questions.prompt: The arrow makes a half turn anti-clockwise. Which way does it point now?
questions.explanation: From pointing down, a half turn anti-clockwise finishes pointing up.

questions.prompt: The arrow makes a quarter turn anti-clockwise. Which way does it point now?
questions.explanation: From pointing left, a quarter turn anti-clockwise finishes pointing down.

questions.prompt: The arrow makes a quarter turn clockwise. Which way does it point now?
questions.explanation: From pointing down, a quarter turn clockwise finishes pointing left.
